changelog:
alibabacloud-waf-rule-management v0.0.1 – Initial public release with major compliance-focused improvements:

- Enforced strict read-only mode: all write/configure/modify operations and script output are explicitly forbidden.
- Introduced session-based User-Agent tracking: every CLI call must use a unique session ID per workflow.
- Enhanced CLI and SLS plugin setup guidance, including postpay/subscription logstore naming and region handling.
- Expanded and clarified pre-checklists, command traps, and absolute prohibitions to protect credentials and prevent misconfiguration.
- Updated documentation for compliance, including mandatory disclaimer and precise audit guidance for all outputs.
- Removed obsolete files; focused all logic/documentation on secure, text-based guidance and diagnostic analysis only.
